claims_not_supported: no absolute or literature Cd validation; the compact domain and 16 cells/D rung are capability fixtures
no grid independence or flow-grid convergence (that is W2b)
no T4/CUDA backend qualification and no Manifest change
no v16 geometry behavior, gradient, FD, topology, optimizer or downforce claim
no target-physics, benchmark, full-vehicle or high-Re claim
claims_supported: WaterLily constructs and time-integrates the registered flow-past-sphere fixture in Float32 on the CLI CPU multi-threaded backend
the W1 GridSDF adapter is consumed by the solver through the GridSDFWaterLilyBody bridge (trilinear value and analytic normal)
the canonical force response is the force on the body in solver units, F_body = -total_force, and its drag sign is exercised on the fixture
the exact-sphere and sampled-sphere geometries produce finite, stationary, same-sign force histories on the same flow grid

affine_map.provenance: registers the W1-measured map for the sphere fixture with D = 1.0 m over 16 solver units

canonical_phi.construction: exact float64 sphere SDF on the lattice, cast to Float32 exactly as genesis stores phi; built through the W1 gate constructor

flow.boundary_conditions: uBC = (U,0,0) Dirichlet normal / Neumann tangential, no periodic direction, exitBC disabled
flow.note: solver length unit = one flow cell; 16 cells per diameter; sim_time is in tU/D units

geometries.analytic: WaterLily AutoBody with the exact sphere SDF in solver coordinates
geometries.sampled: GridSDFWaterLilyBody over the canonical_phi fixture and the registered affine map

gates_registered_before_measurement.G1_completion: both fixtures reach t_end in tU/D units with steps > 0 and no exception
gates_registered_before_measurement.G2_finiteness: all(isfinite, u) and all(isfinite, p) at the end of both runs
gates_registered_before_measurement.G3_force_finite: every sampled force component is finite in both runs
gates_registered_before_measurement.G4_drag_sign: window-mean drag > 0 for both fixtures (exercises F_body = -total_force)
gates_registered_before_measurement.G5_stationarity: |mean_drag(first half) - mean_drag(second half)| / mean_drag(window) <= 0.02 for both fixtures
gates_registered_before_measurement.G6_cross_fixture: |Cd_sampled - Cd_analytic| / Cd_analytic <= 0.10 with Cd = mean_drag / (0.5 * pi * R_solver^2)
gates_registered_before_measurement.G8_reproducibility: a second identical analytic run matches the first in window-mean drag within relative 1e-6
gates_registered_before_measurement.threshold_modification_rule: no bound relaxation after seeing a measurement; a failure is a fail-closed stop with no evidence written, followed by a new registered threshold round

provenance.review_note: runtime fingerprint (Julia, threads, WaterLily, backend) and child peak RSS are recorded per run

registration_note: implementation pre-existed this registration (bridge modules and smoke validation were developed while the user-reviewed W2a plan was being executed); the registration fixes every fixture parameter and gate before the registered evidence run and the runner refuses to run on any criteria/implementation drift
